protocol.prefix_rule: replay every row before rollout_index once, then advance one current row and only generated rows
protocol.outside_arena_rule: reject the candidate endpoint, keep the position, realize zero displacement, and record collision
protocol.persistence_rule: use the starting legal previous displacement direction at the training mean step length
protocol.random_rule: math/rand.NewSource derived from seed and trial ID; target is never read for action generation
protocol.parameter_rule: rollout creates a fresh individual and cannot modify parameters or optimizer state

limitations: The arena, action, and target rules are an engineering evaluator and do not claim animal navigation or a connectome mechanism.
Targets are read separately from the history model input and are used only for scoring.
Before/after labels refer to frozen training snapshots; persistence and random baselines are one baseline phase per seed.

complete_report.trace_hash_encoding: Python json UTF-8 ensure_ascii=false compact separators, insertion order retained; trace arrays kept in external complete report
